label: Living inside the 2022 flood extent (%)
definition: Share of 2023 residents whose ~0.7 km2 cell centre lies inside UNOSAT's cumulative VIIRS flood extent, 1 July-31 August 2022. Exposure of today's population to that flood's footprint, not the number affected at the time
latest_available_wave: No revision of the 2022 (or 2010) extent found. Newer event: UNOSAT FL20250818PAK, VIIRS flood water 26 Aug-7 Sep 2025
currency_note: The indicator measures exposure to the 2022 and 2010 footprints, and those products have not been reissued, so it is current for what it claims. A later flood exists: the 2025 extent is a different event over a 13-day window (2022 is two months), so it is a new indicator, not a new wave. Built as a separate file, shocks-and-security_district_unosat2025.csv.
